summary: First-party Bangladesh Ministry of Land/DLRS custody and a public Shariatpur Sadar plot-geometry response are evidenced. One bounded mouza request returned 1,177 WKT plots, but citywide coverage and stable native identity semantics were not established; runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Bengali discovery queries, exact text, outcomes and actual result URLs are recorded in city-6601-shariatpur.json.
requestOutcomes: Official DLRS, Settlement and Land Zoning pages were fetched. The current Land Zoning JavaScript was inspected; public hierarchy POSTs reached 104 Shariatpur Sadar mouzas and a bounded mouza POST returned 1,177 plot geometries. GeoServer WFS capabilities returned 503.

attemptedRoutes.outcome: Official land-record and survey custodian evidenced.
Official survey-map purchase/search service evidenced; no parcel vector extraction attempted there.
Current public viewer and JavaScript reachable; administrative and geometry routes inspected.
Dhaka → Shariatpur → Shariatpur Sadar → 104 mouzas returned.
Mouza 001-Gazipur returned one sheet and 1,177 WKT plot geometries with source fields.
503 Service Unavailable; not treated as absence.

scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [23.2575135641073, 90.3753147890267] was preserved; no point hit/miss inference was made.
One mouza is not citywide coverage, and Shariatpur city boundary membership was not independently established.
No stable native parcel identity was retained; no GeoJSON sample was written.
No unsafe ownership, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account or personal fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is not source integration/admission; serial reviewer qualification remains required.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only, if independently confirmed
nativeFieldMapping: Observed only in bounded response: gid, plot_no_en, label, m_code, jl_no_en, sht_no_en and geom. No raw attributes retained.
compositeKeyProvenance: m_code, plot_no_en, jl_no_en and sht_no_en were observed as source fields, but their stable identity semantics were not independently documented.
crs: EPSG:4326 declared by the official viewer's WKT parser; independent service metadata unavailable.
geometryQuality: 1,177 valid-looking WKT MULTIPOLYGON strings returned in a bounded response; no retained sample and no citywide quality assessment.

requestEvidence: Bounded public response returned sheets=1 and plots=1177.
